messages:
marta: Onboarding request for halley-3b (int4) into dev-stg. Doing an initial sanity/bring-up pass now — putting quick checklist and notes here. cc @kai @rachel :mag:

marta: Checklist (quick):
• basic tokenization smoke
• short QA + instruction sanity prompts
• kvcache/token continuity at long contexts
• perf numbers (latency/p50, p95) vs satori-3b-fp16 baseline
• run 1k eval harness (if quick) and compare rouge/acc metrics

kai: I'll take tokenization + kvcache checks. Any special tokenizer files or custom merges?

marta: No custom merges — using model-provided tokenizer.json. Quick curl test I used: 
```
curl -s -X POST "https://dev.api.redwood/v1/models/halley-3b/generate" \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEV_TOKEN" \\n  -d '{"prompt":"Who wrote 'Pride and Prejudice'?","max_tokens":40}'
```
Got coherent answer but saw trailing repetition on longer prompts (see below).

rachel: Ran a couple of instruction prompts (summarize, step-by-step). Short ones look fine. Longer multi-paragraph summary had truncation at ~512 tokens and then repeated the last sentence. Snippet: 
```
... therefore the main takeaway is X. therefore the main takeaway is X. therefore the main takeaway is X.
```

kai: That smells like an attention/kv indexing mismatch when we switch to int4 layout. Will try reproducing with `--kv-check` build.

kai: Command I'm running: 
```
./runtime --model halley-3b-int4 --kv-check --input-file repro_prompt.txt --log-level debug
```

marta: Started an eval run against 1k prompts (subset of our instr-follow and qa sets) comparing to satori-3b-fp16 baseline. If metric delta > 3% we'll flag as regression. ETA ~ 25-35m.

devops-bot: deploy: halley-3b-int4 uploaded to dev-stg pool "dev-gpu-7". rollout status: 1/3 nodes completed, 2 pending. CI tags: build-2312, quant-int4-v2.

rachel: Also saw a small increase in latency p95 (~12% up) on single-socket runs — could be quant-decompression overhead. Recording numbers now.

kai: If kv indexing is off we'll see misaligned cache keys in the debug logs. When you have the log, paste the KV lineage lines (they look like `KV_LOAD key=0x... idx=...`).

marta: Pasted one fragment where it spikes + repeat: 
```
[2026-03-20T12:34:56Z] KV_LOAD key=0x7f1a2 idx=511 -> miss, fallback=kernel-copy
[2026-03-20T12:34:56Z] ATTENTION_MATMUL shape=(8,512) seq=1024 -> fused-kernel used
[2026-03-20T12:34:56Z] OUTPUT: "... therefore the main takeaway is X. therefore the main takeaway is X."
```

kai: Good repro, thanks. I'll try to bisect between quant-v1 and quant-v2 kernels and run the same prompt. If it's kernel-related we can revert kernel selection for int4 until we fix.

rachel: Prioritization: medium-high. If it affects multi-paragraph outputs it's a regression for doc-summarization use-cases. But low-volume for now (dev-stg only). :warning:

marta: Action items: 
1) kai to run kv-index bisect + open issue with logs and seed.
2) rachel to collect perf numbers and attach comparison table vs satori-3b-fp16.
3) marta to let eval finish and attach metric diff. If >3% pause rollout.

ci-bot: CI: created issue #ML-5426 -> "halley-3b int4 dev-stg repeats/truncation" assigned to @kai, labels: bug, regression, kv-cache.

kai: Opening PR for a quick revert of the new fused-kernel selection for int4 if repro holds. If not, will continue deeper debug.

marta: Thanks. For traceability I'm marking model state: dev-stg:quarantine -> needs-investigation. Will update once eval done (ETA ~30m).

rachel: 👍 adding a couple extra repro prompts to the issue, including one that triggers repetition within ~200 tokens.

kai: on it — will update thread with bisect results and a small repro script.

marta: Filing follow-up: postmortem template if this becomes production-impacting. For now keep in dev-stg and don't promote to dedicated.

(END)
